g.text: YOCO-3B, upstream recipe, eight H100 GPUs (80 GB) · loss in bits per token · held-out: 1.64M fineweb-edu + 0.41M code tokens, mixed 0.8 / 0.2
Consistent at a checkpoint if |E1|, |E2| and |S| ≤ |Y| (S = Faster-YOCO seed 2 − seed 1, not drawn). Checkpoints consistent: held-out mix 10/10, fineweb 10/10, code 5/10,
training loss (1,000-update mean) 7/10; all four at the final checkpoint. Seed 2 of Faster-YOCO ran on a second host of the same model.
